title: Analysis and Detection of Stagnation in Floating-Point Summation
summary: Stagnation in the summation of floating-point numbers occurs when the running sum, or the accumulator, does not change its value despite addends being greater than zero. Here we define different types of stagnation - commonly referred to as swamping or absorption, where one operand in an addition is nearly or completely rounded off---in floating-point summation, and propose algorithms for detecting it in numerical code that uses floating-point arithmetic.
